hints.title: Bar Enclosure State
hints.text: Vertical bars '|' act as toggles for whether subsequent characters are inside or outside an excluded pair.

hints.title: Boolean Flag Tracking
hints.text: Maintain inside_pair boolean, inverting its state every time a '|' character is encountered.

hints.title: Counting Outside Asterisks
hints.text: Increment asterisk count only when inside_pair is false and current character is '*'.

hints.title: State Toggle Asterisk Counter Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass with a boolean state flag.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No complex failure mode; simple linear scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate inverts flag on vertical bar without tracking nested depths since pairs are disjoint.
